Reason for Mistake: The error occurred when WebSurfer failed to adequately differentiate between conflicting data points about Maurice Tourneur's birth year (1873 vs. 1876) and did not explicitly resolve the discrepancy, despite having access to reliable sources like IMDb, Wikipedia, and Britannica. Instead of consolidating or cross-referencing this information systematically, the agent prematurely accepted one reported value (1876) without reconciling it with the conflicting information. This led to incomplete validation and resolution of the key comparative data (birth dates of the two directors), which was critical to solving the problem.
